blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senate deputy majority leader Sen. Joel Villanueva on Wednesday asked Vice President Sara Duterte’s spokesperson Atty. Paolo Panelo if he should have thrown a fit over the prosecution’s move to drop three of the four articles of impeachment against Duterte. Panelo, in a statement, questioned the “lack of outrage” of the Senate majority for the time and money supposedly wasted from the prosecution’s presentation that will no longer be accounted for in the Senate impeachment court’s final verdict. “What does he want me to do?
